abs_io.ioig_anzsic.description: IOIG to ANZSIC 2006 class concordance as published by the ABS with the input-output methodology ('Industry and Product Concordance Tables', sheet 'IOIG(2022) to ANZSIC06'), one row per IOIG x class (basis 'published'). Where the tables publish an IOIG that the concordance splits (1205 'Wine, spirits and tobacco' in 2023-24, the concordance's 1203 and 1204), rows for it are added with a 'derived' basis, so every IOIG in the tables maps to classes. Class 6711 maps to two IOIGs (imputed and actual rent) in the published concordance.
